view.name: Layer stack panel
view.description: Stack panel listing catalogue/footprint/MOC overlays and HiPS survey layers with visibility, settings and delete controls.

regions.label: Full-bleed WebGL sky view (HiPS survey imagery) with catalog markers, instrument footprint polygons, coverage map, reticle, FoV readout and zoom +/- buttons
Top-left coordinate frame select (ICRS), copy button, target/coordinate search field; top-right projection (SIN) and fullscreen buttons
Vertical icon rail: layers stack (active, green border), settings, reticle, goto/globe, share
'Stack' layer manager panel: overlays list (notes, footprints, catalogs, MOC coverage) with eye/settings/delete buttons, and surveys list with dropdown selects plus per-layer controls; close X

evidence.note: Pannable/zoomable celestial sky map with survey imagery base and layered catalog markers (red circles SIMBAD, green diamonds YSO candidates, orange squares Gaia), footprint polygons and a coverage region

patterns.rationale: Map is celestial (sky survey) rather than geographic; coded as the nearest entry. Live click on a marker highlighted it and opened a SIMBAD row table at the bottom.

evidence.note: Stack panel opened from the layers rail button, floating non-modal over the sky, with close button

patterns.rationale: Could also be read as a drawer or menu; it is anchored beside the rail button (no arrow) and holds layer controls.

evidence.note: Hover label for the layers button
Four survey dropdown selects with 24 HiPS options incl. 'More...'
Object/coordinate search input, magenta monospace text, outlined
Stack panel floats beside the rail, not edge-anchored sliding panel

patterns.rationale: Panel is not attached to a screen edge; coded as popover instead.

evidence.note: Source table only appears after clicking a marker; not in capture

patterns.rationale: Catalog row table appears only after live interaction, not in the captured state.

structure.layout: full-bleed interactive sky-map canvas with floating toolbars: top-left frame/search bar, left icon rail with an open layer-stack panel, right-edge zoom buttons, top-right projection/fullscreen

aesthetics.typography: Generic monospace (browser default) for all UI text: panel title, layer names, selects, coordinate input, FoV readout
aesthetics.typeScale: Nearly flat: 16px bold 'Stack' panel title vs 14px regular everywhere else

notes: Aladin Lite astronomy viewer. Whole viewport is a dark sky survey image (nebula, bright stars) overlaid with colour-coded catalog symbols (red circles SIMBAD, teal diamonds YSO candidates, orange squares Gaia, yellow discs 'My notes'), lime/purple/orange/cyan instrument footprint polygons, and a translucent orange KMOS coverage MOC. UI chrome is deliberately plain: light-grey #ececec boxes with 2px dark borders, 3px radii, monospace text, square 30px icon buttons (eye, gear, trash, sync, download). Active rail button gets a green border; close button is a red X. Coordinates in the search field are magenta. Clicking a marker (live) highlights it green and opens a bottom table of the source's catalog row. 'Powered by Aladin Lite' logo bottom right.
